findings.claim: 10-K FY2025 describes channel sales via cloud-provider partnerships, which give access to their large customer bases and expand distribution capabilities.
findings.excerpt: The existing footprint of these providers provides us with access to their large customer base and expands our distribution capabilities.

findings.claim: Palantir announced a multi-tiered partnership with Google Cloud making Palantir available on Google Cloud Marketplace.
findings.source: MarketBeat: Why Palantir's Google Cloud Deal Could Change the Debate
findings.excerpt: The multi-tiered partnership makes Palantir available on Google Cloud Marketplace and establishes two-way data federation between BigQuery and Foundry, as well as deeper connectivity between Gemini and Palantir AIP.

channel_business_model_shift.note: 搜尋結果顯示 Google Cloud Marketplace 合作（約 2026-06）；但未找到有一手來源的商業模式結構性轉變。聚合站的通路營收占比數字無一手引用，未採用。 線索 1 條，程式核實 1 條
